about_the_game:
Dive into danger, sharpen your blade, and test your skill.

The Treasure Below is a third person action game with stylized medieval visuals, satisfying melee combat, and ever-increasing challenges.

Master a variety of weapons, each with unique attacks and skills—fast moving swords, long reaching polearms, heavy-hitting great axes, and more.

Arena Mode puts your skill to the test: fight through escalating waves of monsters, each deadlier than the last. Survive long enough, and you’ll earn access to greater rewards and tougher challenges.

Adventure Mode Descend into dangerous dungeons and uncover ancient treasures in a series of handcrafted levels.

Online Co-op Team up with a friend to take on monsters together. No PvP—just pure cooperative action.

There’s no story, no lore, no cutscenes—just pure gameplay. Jump in, gear up, and see how far you can go.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD 2.5 GHz or superior
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 770 or AMD Radeon R7 360
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
